title: Work Entry
description: Frontmatter schema for files in 01 Work/. One file per entry, append-only.

uid.description: ULID identifier. Unique across all vault entries.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the entry was recorded (YYYY-MM-DD).

author.description: GitHub handle of the person who wrote this entry (e.g. '@maya').

participants.description: Additional people who contributed to or were present for this work.
